messages:
sara: :wave: Quick ask — need to rejigger the Enablement Roadshow schedule next week. Exec conflict for one of our EMEA mornings, so we need to move the HelixCare slot to avoid blocking their renewal prep. Customers impacted: HelixCare (renewal in 3 weeks, high touch), AeroHealth (onboarding). Can we swap an APAC slot or shift times? Proposed swaps below.

james: ok — can you paste the current slots so I can check presenter availability?

sara: sure — current slots: ```
Mon 09:00 GMT — Veridian (customer workshop)
Tue 08:00 GMT — HelixCare (enablement, renewal touchpoint)
Tue 22:00 SGT — APAC open slot
Wed 14:00 PST — AeroHealth (onboarding labs)
Thu 11:00 GMT — General office hours
```

nina: HelixCare prefer Tue 09:00 GMT or Thu 11:00 GMT. AeroHealth said afternoon PST works best for them, flexible.

mike_onboarding: I can cover a later SGT slot — willing to move Tue 22:00 SGT to Tue 14:00 SGT if that helps. Proposed agenda if we shift: 30m product tour, 45m hands-on guided lab, 15m Q&A + next steps. I'll prepare prework. Link to template: https://tiny.redwood/templates/enablement-agenda

sara: thanks — sounds good. If we swap APAC <-> EMEA, we avoid delaying HelixCare and reduce renewal risk. Action: need calendar invites updated, slides + prework, and customer confirmation. I'll capture renewal risk in the CS tracker.

james: I can update calendar invites and notify CS managers. @mike_onboarding can you confirm slides + prework by EOD Friday?

mike_onboarding: :thumbsup: confirmed — will update slides, add a 15-min prework checklist, and drop the link in the thread when ready.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: invites updated — HelixCare moved to Tue 09:00 GMT, APAC slot moved to Tue 14:00 SGT, AeroHealth remains Wed 14:00 PST. New invites sent.

nina: I'll reach out to HelixCare to confirm Tue 09:00 GMT and escalate any issues.

sara: capturing action items: 1) james — update invites & CS managers (in progress), 2) mike_onboarding — slides + prework (due EOD Fri), 3) nina — confirm with HelixCare, 4) sara — update renewal risk in CS tracker and flag AM if not confirmed.

james: done — calendar invites updated and Asana task created: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321

sara: great, closing loop. I'll report status in Monday sync. :pray:
